about: A made-up worked example for the gallery: Northline, a crew-scheduling vendor, pitching Harlow Services, a field-service company with 62 crews. Every name, number and quote is invented. Each entry under slides is the props for that layout (an array shows it more than once, on different tones); the gallery adds id and label.

objection-question-answer.answer: Yesterday's routes are on every crew's phone already.
